questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy clearly identifies climate action as a core purpose. The policy outlines a commitment to environmental responsibility, carbon neutrality, and sustainability. It acknowledges climate change as the most complex problem of this generation and recognizes the urgent responsibility to act by becoming a community leader in climate change adaptation and mitigation. The policy also outlines specific actions to reduce carbon emissions from Council operations and the wider community, and to increase the community's adaptability and resilience to a changing climate. These actions include implementing a Resilient South Local Action Plan, undertaking a climate adaptation risk assessment, investigating opportunities for urban cooling, and increasing tree canopy. The policy also includes actions to reduce waste to landfill, improve water efficiency, and support sustainable living. These actions are all aimed at mitigating the impacts of climate change and adapting to its effects.
